rows.en: No... But, Reborns Gundam, if we can just defeat you, it'll all be over.
What!?

...I could never lose... The one to unite the world... and lead it to the coming dialogue...
...is me... Reborns Gundam...!!
Wrong...!! It will never be you!!
You... You mere hero!!
I... We will carve out the future!!
...I could never lose... The one to unite the world... and lead it to the coming dialogue...
...is me... Reborns Gundam...
And at that very moment!!
What the...!!
A crack ran across the far wall, and a Ride Gate opened up.
And out of it emerged a sinister shadow!!
Fuhahahahahahahaha...!!!
Looks like I was a step too late! That Reborns...!!

notes.note: #0.39-51 continue story_141's leader pairs ('What!?' + 'But if we beat you') in the 0659 chain order: #0.38/39 W, #0.40/41 Momotaros (rough 'omee' -> 'ya'), #0.42-51 Taro, Seven, Ultraman, RX, Rider 1. #0.39 is W's longer variant (opens with 'iya', adds 'everything ends'). Subject 'we' restored as in story_141.
Ribbons accepting the fight before the battle (GoToBattle 509 follows in the script).

#0.54-55: Reborns defeated; one sentence split across rows, cut at the matching point ('The one who leads... / ...is me'). 'Kitarubeki taiwa' = the 'coming dialogue' (00 movie term), kept literal. #0.63-64 are the alternate branch (no 00 exchange); #0.63 identical to #0.54, #0.64 ends without '!!'.
00 (Setsuna) denying that Ribbons is the one to lead the world: 'omae de aru mono ka' -> 'It will never be you!!'.
'Ore ga, oretachi ga...' echoes Setsuna's 'I am... We are Gundam' pattern -> 'I... We will carve out the future!!'.
Ankh's 'nanda...!!' reacting to the tremor -> 'What the...!!'.

UNCERTAIN: 'ippo osokatta ka' read as Belial arriving a step too late to help/stop Reborns (he then says Reborns 'didn't die for nothing'). Could also mean Reborns himself was too slow. 'Riboonzu no yatsu' left trailing as 'That Reborns...!!'.
'Ore-sama' -> 'I, the great Belial' (as earlier slices render his ore-sama).

#0.92-106 and #0.108-122 use 0669.bla's second Pt_Chara_Check chain, 15,14,...,1 = Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, 00, Wing Zero, God, Zeta, Nu, OOO, W, Den-O (Momotaros), RX, Rider 1. Confirmed by voice: #0.104 and #0.120 (slot 12) are Momotaros-rough, #0.108 (slot 0) is Zero's 'saseru ka yo', #0.119 (slot 11) Shotaro's 'mon ka'. 'Kisama' -> 'You fiend', 'omae' (#0.102 OOO, #0.103 W) -> 'You...'. Trailing 'nani wo' given the verb 'plotting'.
Momotaros slot: 'temee!! nani wo!!' -> 'Why you!! What're you up to!!'.
Zero slot 'saseru ka yo' -> 'Like I'd... let you do that!!' (same English as an earlier slice's identical line).
Momotaros slot: 'temee, kono yarou!! nna koto, sasenee zo!!' -> 'Why, you son of a...!! I ain't lettin' you pull that!!'.
Belial countering the party's charge: 'otto' -> 'Whoa there...!!'.
#0.124-126: first three pain cries of a 15-row block (Zero, Mebius, Taro) that continues in story_143.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader blocks: #0.39-51 follow the 0659 chain (as story_141); #0.92-126 follow 0669.bla's descending chain 15..1 (Zero first), confirmed by voice. Uncertain: #0.74 who was 'a step too late'. No new names.
